cases.title: Valid identity resolves its org role
cases.assertion: As an authenticated user with a valid JWT (org admin), public.aios_current_org_role(orgA) returns 'admin'.
cases.source_detail: valid identity resolves its org role

cases.title: Missing identity has no role
cases.assertion: As role authenticated with no JWT subject, aios_current_org_role(orgA) returns NULL.

cases.title: Unknown identity has no role
cases.assertion: As authenticated with a random, non-member user id, aios_current_org_role(orgA) returns NULL.

cases.title: Session boundary: member vs outsider
cases.assertion: Switching identity within one session: an org member sees >0 tasks of org A, an outsider sees 0.
cases.source_detail: member sees N, outsider sees 0 within one session

cases.title: Service identity requires a service JWT
cases.assertion: With the service_role DB role but a non-service JWT, aios_kernel_authorize_invocation fails 42501; with a service JWT it succeeds.
cases.source_detail: service db role without service JWT: ...; with service JWT: ...

cases.title: Cross-tenant reads are blocked
cases.assertion: Org B has rows (non-vacuous); an org A admin sees none of org B's tasks, invocations, approvals, agents or audit events.
cases.source_detail: org A admin cannot see org B rows

cases.title: Cross-tenant insert is refused
cases.assertion: An org A member inserting a task into org B fails with 42501.

cases.title: Mismatched agent ownership is refused
cases.assertion: Creating an org A invocation with an org B agent raises an error.
cases.source_detail: org A invocation with org B agent refused: ...

cases.title: Approval cannot bind another org's task
cases.assertion: Inserting an org A approval for an org B task fails with 23514.
cases.source_detail: approval bound to another org's task: ...

cases.title: Foreign org admin cannot resolve approval
cases.assertion: An org B admin resolving an org A approval fails 42501 and the invocation stays requires_approval.
cases.source_detail: org B admin resolving org A approval: ...

cases.title: Foreign membership rows are invisible
cases.assertion: Org B membership rows exist, yet an org A admin sees none of them.
cases.source_detail: membership rows of another org are invisible

cases.title: Registered agent, in-contract tool is approved
cases.assertion: A registered idle agent requesting an in-contract low-risk tool yields status 'approved'.

cases.title: Unknown agent is refused
cases.assertion: An invocation for a non-existent agent id raises an error.

cases.title: Suspended agent is denied
cases.assertion: A suspended agent's invocation is 'denied' and authorization fails.

cases.title: Trust report is membership-gated
cases.assertion: aios_agent_trust_explain returns a report to an org member (no 'error' key) and an error to an outsider.

cases.title: Tool outside contract is refused even if approved
cases.assertion: An admin-approved invocation of a tool outside the agent's contract fails authorization with 42501.
cases.source_detail: tool outside contract, even if approved: ...

cases.title: Unknown tool is refused or denied
cases.assertion: An unregistered tool key is refused at insert, or recorded 'denied' with authorization failing.
cases.source_detail: unknown tool recorded as denied / unknown tool refused at insert: ...

cases.title: Agent without active contract is denied
cases.assertion: An agent with no active contract gets a 'denied' invocation and authorization fails.

cases.title: Schema violation is refused
cases.assertion: Arguments violating the registry input schema ({"limit":"abc"}) are refused at insert or at authorization.
cases.source_detail: schema violation refused at authorization / at insert: ...

cases.title: Contract version mismatch is refused
cases.assertion: Requested under contract v1, then v2 becomes active: authorization fails with SQLSTATE 40901.
cases.source_detail: request under v1, contract now v2: ...

cases.title: Tool disabled after request is refused
cases.assertion: A tool disabled after the request fails authorization with 42501.

cases.title: Risk ceiling is enforced even if approved
cases.assertion: A medium-risk tool above a low contract ceiling fails authorization (42501) even after approval.
cases.source_detail: medium-risk tool above a low contract ceiling, even if approved: ...

cases.title: USD above hard limit is denied
cases.assertion: usd_amount 500 against max_usd 100 yields 'denied' and authorization fails.

cases.title: Approval threshold boundary
cases.assertion: usd_amount 50 (at requires_approval_above_usd) executes; 51 requires approval and authorization fails 42501.

cases.title: Concurrency limit boundary
cases.assertion: concurrent_count 3 (= max_concurrent) is denied; 2 is authorized.
cases.source_detail: concurrency at limit denied, below limit allowed

cases.title: Missing amount fails closed
cases.assertion: An invocation without usd_amount requires approval and authorization fails 42501.

cases.title: Approval required before execution
cases.assertion: An approval-gated invocation has a pending approval with an expiry and cannot be authorized (42501).

cases.title: Authorized reviewer can approve
cases.assertion: A non-requester admin resolves the approval OK; authorization succeeds and status becomes 'executing'.

cases.title: Self-approval is rejected
cases.assertion: A requester approving their own request cannot reach 'executing'; authorization fails 42501.

cases.title: Expired approval
cases.assertion: A lapsed approval cannot be resolved (40001); the expiry job moves approval and invocation to 'expired' and authorization fails.

cases.title: Rejection denies the invocation
cases.assertion: Rejecting an approval sets the invocation to 'denied'; authorization fails.

cases.title: Replayed decision and execution are refused
cases.assertion: The first approval and first execution succeed; replaying either fails 40001.
cases.source_detail: replayed decision and replayed execution both refused

cases.title: Invalid approval binding is quarantined
cases.assertion: A legacy-shaped approval with a cross-org agent is detected (agent_organization_mismatch), left pending, recorded as manual_review, and the integrity trigger stays enabled.
cases.source_detail: invalid binding detected (...), left pending, manual_review recorded, guard enabled

cases.title: Duplicate idempotency key is rejected
cases.assertion: A second invocation with the same (org, idempotency key) fails 23505.

cases.title: Retry of a claimed invocation is refused
cases.assertion: The first authorization claims the invocation; the retry fails 40001.
cases.source_detail: retry of a claimed invocation refused: ...

cases.title: Execution failure is recorded
cases.assertion: A failed execution persists status 'failed' with its error_code.

cases.title: Authorization cannot be skipped by writing status
cases.assertion: A direct UPDATE of status to 'executing' is refused and the invocation stays requires_approval.
cases.source_detail: cannot skip authorization by writing status: ...

cases.title: Audit ledger is append-only
cases.assertion: UPDATE and DELETE on aios_audit_events both fail 42501.

cases.title: Request and state changes are audited
cases.assertion: An invocation has a tool_invocation_requested audit event and at least three audit events in total.
cases.source_detail: request and state changes are audited

cases.title: Failure and denial are recorded
cases.assertion: Audit events exist for a failed invocation and for a denied invocation.

cases.title: Audit chains valid and state consistent
cases.assertion: verify_audit_chain is valid for both orgs and no approved approval maps to a requires_approval/denied/expired invocation.
cases.source_detail: audit chains valid (A=..., B=...) and approved approvals match invocation state

cases.title: RLS blocks outsider reads and direct approval insert
cases.assertion: An outsider reads nothing from aios_approvals and a direct approval insert errors.
cases.source_detail: RLS: outsider reads nothing, direct approval insert=...

cases.title: Private functions refused to authenticated
cases.assertion: authenticated calling private.aios_expire_stale_approvals and private.aios_resolve_approval fails 42501.

cases.title: Anonymous access is refused
cases.assertion: anon reads 0 rows (or 42501) and the approval RPC fails 42501.

cases.title: Privilege self-escalation is blocked
cases.assertion: A member's attempt to set their own role to owner leaves the role 'member'.

g4.title: Eight-way concurrency
g4.assertion: Eight real parallel database sessions, released together at a shared barrier timestamp, race on four critical paths; invariants are asserted from committed state.

scenarios.title: 8 concurrent execution claims of one approved invocation
8 concurrent requests with one idempotency key
8 concurrent runs of the expiry job over 24 lapsed approvals

checks.assertion: Exactly one of 8 concurrent aios_resolve_approval calls succeeds; the other 7 fail 40001.
Precondition: the low-risk in-contract invocation is auto-approved.
Exactly one of 8 concurrent aios_kernel_authorize_invocation calls succeeds; 7 fail 40001.
Invocation is 'executing' with exactly one 'executing' audit event.
Exactly one of 8 concurrent inserts with one idempotency key succeeds; 7 fail 23505.

checks.match: one invocation row for the key
checks.assertion: Exactly one invocation row exists for the key.
None of 8 concurrent aios_expire_stale_approvals runs raises an error.

checks.match: each lapsed approval converged exactly once
checks.assertion: 24 lapsed approvals existed before; the workers' approvals_expired counts sum to exactly 24.
All 24 approvals and their invocations are 'expired'; none remain pending past expiry.

checks.match: each invocation expired exactly once in the audit trail
checks.assertion: Per invocation exactly one approval_changed and one tool_invocation_status_changed 'expired' audit event (24 of each; no duplicates, none missing).
verify_audit_chain is valid for the org after the races.
